metadata.scenario: A patient contacts the billing team to dispute a charge for a procedure they claim was covered by insurance. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi Margaret, this is Dorothy Henderson. I'm calling about a charge I noticed on my bill that I believe should have been covered by my insurance. I understand, Dorothy. Let’s take a look at that. Can you provide me with the specific charge you’re referring to? Yes, it’s for the physical therapy session from two weeks ago. Got it. Just a moment while I pull up your account. Okay, I see the charge here. It looks like there was a co-pay applied. Can you confirm if you filed a claim with your insurance for this session? Yes, I did. I received confirmation that it should be fully covered. I’m not sure why I’m being charged. I see. Let me check the notes on your account regarding the insurance claim. It appears there might have been an issue with the submission date. I’ll need to contact our billing department to clarify this further. That would be great. I really need this resolved as soon as possible. Absolutely, I understand your concern. Would you like me to follow up with you via phone or email once I have more information? Please call me at this number. I’d prefer to discuss it directly. Sure, I’ll make a note to call you back. Is there anything else you’d like to discuss while I have you on the line? Actually, yes. I was also wondering if there are any other services available for my post-surgery recovery. We offer additional services like medication management and companion care, which might be beneficial. Would you like to know more about those? Yes, I think medication management could be helpful. Great choice! Our medication management service includes reminders and supervision. It’s priced at $65 to $80 per session. That sounds reasonable. Can I schedule a session for next week? Certainly! I can set that up for you. Would you prefer a morning visit with a female caregiver? Yes, please. Perfect. I’ll arrange for a female caregiver to visit you Monday morning. I’ll confirm the details when I call back about the billing issue. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help today. You’re very welcome, Dorothy. I’ll make sure to follow up with you soon. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
